## ✨ Highlights

- **macOS 27 look** — the app now follows the new window style on macOS 27.
- **Bug fixes** — downloaded `hk` no longer blocked by Gatekeeper; project-scoped CLI child skills no longer shown as global; `opencode.json` entries no longer missed when `opencode.jsonc` coexists.
